question: The police of which of the following States developed an app called 'Disha' for women's safety in February 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Andhra Pradesh police developed an app called 'Disha' for women's safety in February 2020.
 
• The 'Disha' app was named after a woman who was a victim of a heinous crime in the state, sparking outrage and a call for enhanced safety measures.
 
• The app aims to provide rapid assistance to women in distress with features such as SOS, police station locator, and nearby hospital locator.
 
• It is part of a larger initiative by the Andhra Pradesh government to improve women's safety, including the Disha Act which aims to expedite the trial and punishment of crimes against women.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Disha App**

 
 
• The Disha app was developed to enhance the safety and security of women in the state of Andhra Pradesh.
 
• It includes features such as an SOS button which, when pressed, sends an immediate alert to the nearest police control room.
 
• The app also provides information on the nearest police stations and hospitals, making it easier for women to seek help in emergencies.
 
• It is part of the broader Disha initiative, which includes the Disha Act, aimed at fast-tracking the trial and conviction of offenders in crimes against women.
 
 
 
• **Women's Safety Initiatives in India**
 
 
• Various states in India have launched different initiatives to enhance women's safety, including the She Teams in Telangana and the Suraksha app in Karnataka.
 
• The Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India, has also launched initiatives like the One Stop Centre Scheme and the Women's Helpline 181.
 
• These initiatives aim to provide immediate assistance to women in distress and ensure their safety and protection.
